proposals.before: On Yichou of the first month of spring in the first year of Jianshi, the temple of the Imperial great-grandfather Dao Kao suffered a disaster.
proposals.after: On Yichou of the first month of spring in the first year of Jianshi, the temple of the imperial great-grandfather Daokao suffered a disaster.
proposals.reason: 悼考 is the single posthumous designation Daokao in the ancestor temple name, not two separate name words.

proposals.before: Jianshi first year spring first month Yichou, Imperial great-grandfather Dao Kao temple disaster.
proposals.after: Jianshi first year, spring, first month, Yichou: the temple of the imperial great-grandfather Daokao suffered a disaster.
proposals.reason: 悼考 is the single posthumous designation Daokao, and 廟 is the temple governed by the disaster predicate.

proposals.before: Enfeoffed maternal uncle's various officials Guanglu Grandee and Guannei Marquis Wang Chong as Marquis of Ancheng.
proposals.after: His maternal uncle Wang Chong, who held the offices of Zhuli and Guanglu Grandee and the rank of Guannei Marquis, was enfeoffed as Marquis of Ancheng.
proposals.reason: 諸吏 is an office title held by Wang Chong; translating it as “various officials” invents a plural group and breaks the sentence.

proposals.before: Enfeoffed maternal uncle various officials Guanglu Grandee Guannei Marquis Wang Chong as Ancheng Marquis.
proposals.after: Enfeoffed maternal uncle Zhuli, Guanglu Grandee, Guannei Marquis Wang Chong as Marquis of Ancheng.
proposals.reason: 諸吏 is Wang Chong's office title Zhuli, not the plural phrase “various officials.”

proposals.before: Dongping King Yu had a crime and was pared of Fan and Kangfu counties.
proposals.after: Dongping King Yu committed an offense and was deprived of Fan and Kangfu counties.
proposals.reason: 削 here means that the two counties were removed from the king's domain; “was pared of” is ungrammatical and obscures that action.

proposals.before: Dongping King Yu had crime, pared Fan, Kangfu counties.
proposals.after: Dongping King Yu had committed an offense; Fan and Kangfu counties were removed from his domain.
proposals.reason: 削樊、亢父縣 records removal of the counties from the king's domain, which the current wording does not express coherently.

proposals.before: In the seventh month, a small girl named Chen from Sishang who held a bow heard the great flood was coming; she ran into the Horizontal City Gate, forced her way into the Shangfang lateral gate, and reached the Hooked Shield office in Weiyang Palace.
proposals.after: In the seventh month, a small girl from Sishang named Chen Chigong heard that the great flood was coming; she ran through the Horizontal City Gate, forced her way through the Shangfang side gate, and reached the Hooked Shield office in Weiyang Palace.
proposals.reason: 陳持弓 is the girl's full personal name, Chen Chigong; 持弓 is not a relative clause meaning that she held a bow.

proposals.before: Seventh month, Sishang small girl Chen held a bow; hearing the great flood was coming, she ran into the Horizontal City Gate, forced her way into the Shangfang lateral gate, and reached the Hooked Shield office in Weiyang Palace.
proposals.after: Seventh month: a small girl from Sishang, Chen Chigong, heard that the great flood was coming; she ran through the Horizontal City Gate, forced her way through the Shangfang side gate, and reached the Hooked Shield office in Weiyang Palace.
proposals.reason: 陳持弓 is the personal name Chen Chigong, not “Chen held a bow.”

proposals.before: In the fifth month, central usher chief Chen Lin killed Commander of the Capital Region Commandant Yuan Feng in the middle of the hall.
proposals.after: In the fifth month, Central Usher Chief Chen Lin killed Capital Region Commandant Yuan Feng in the middle of the hall.
proposals.reason: The current English duplicates the office head (“Commander” and “Commandant”) for the single title 司隸校尉.

proposals.before: Fifth month, central usher chief Chen Lin killed Commander of Capital Region Commandant Yuan Feng in hall middle.
proposals.after: Fifth month: Central Usher Chief Chen Lin killed Capital Region Commandant Yuan Feng in the middle of the hall.
proposals.reason: 司隸校尉 is one office title; the current wording incorrectly supplies both “Commander” and “Commandant.”

proposals.before: Jingning first year fifth month, Emperor Yuan collapsed.
proposals.after: In the fifth month of the first year of Jingning, Emperor Yuan died.
proposals.reason: 崩 is the conventional verb for a ruler's death, not a statement that Emperor Yuan physically collapsed.

proposals.before: In the fifth month of summer, officials of 800 piculs and 500 piculs ranks were removed.
proposals.after: In the fifth month of summer, the 800- and 500-picul salary grades for officials were abolished.
proposals.reason: 除 modifies the two salary grades 秩; the Chinese abolishes those grades rather than removing the officials who held them.

proposals.before: Summer fifth month, removed officials 800 piculs, 500 piculs ranks.
proposals.after: Summer, fifth month: abolished the 800-picul and 500-picul salary grades for officials.
proposals.reason: 除 modifies the two salary grades 秩; the Chinese abolishes those grades rather than removing the officials who held them.

proposals.before: On Renxu of the third month of spring in the third year, eight fallen stones in Dongjun.
proposals.after: On Renxu of the third month of spring in the third year, eight stones fell in Dong Commandery.
proposals.reason: The current sentence is missing its finite verb; 隕石東郡，八 states that eight stones fell in Dong Commandery.

proposals.before: Third year spring third month Renxu, fallen stone Dongjun, eight.
proposals.after: Third year, spring, third month, Renxu: eight stones fell in Dong Commandery.
proposals.reason: The current sentence is missing its finite verb; 隕石東郡，八 states that eight stones fell in Dong Commandery.

proposals.before: In the sixth month of summer, Yingchuan iron official convicts Shentu Sheng and 180 others killed the chief officials, stole storehouse weapons, called themselves generals, and experienced nine commanderies.
proposals.after: In the sixth month of summer, 180 convicts from the Yingchuan iron office, including Shentu Sheng, killed the chief officials, stole weapons from the arsenal, called themselves generals, and passed through nine commanderies.
proposals.reason: 等百八十人 gives a total of 180 people, not Shentu Sheng plus 180 others, and 經歷九郡 means that they passed through nine commanderies rather than experienced them.

proposals.before: Summer sixth month, Yingchuan iron official convicts Shentu Sheng etc. 180 people killed chief officials, stole storehouse weapons, self called generals, experienced nine commanderies.
proposals.after: Summer, sixth month: 180 convicts from the Yingchuan iron office, including Shentu Sheng, killed chief officials, stole arsenal weapons, called themselves generals, and passed through nine commanderies.
proposals.reason: 等百八十人 gives a total of 180 people, and 經歷九郡 means that they passed through nine commanderies rather than experienced them.

proposals.before: Sent the Chancellor's chief clerk and Imperial Secretary's central overseer to pursue and capture them, undertaking affairs with military mobilization, and all submitted to their guilt.
proposals.after: The Chancellor's chief clerk and the Imperial Secretary's central overseer were sent to pursue and capture them under wartime regulations, and all were punished for their crimes.
proposals.reason: 以軍興從事 describes proceeding under military-mobilization rules, while 伏辜 means suffering punishment for one's crimes; 'submitted to their guilt' is not intelligible English.

proposals.before: Sent Chancellor chief clerk, Imperial Secretary central overseer pursue capture, with military rise undertake affairs, all submitted guilt.
proposals.after: Sent the Chancellor's chief clerk and the Imperial Secretary's central overseer to pursue and capture them under military-mobilization rules; all were punished for their crimes.
proposals.reason: 以軍興從事 describes proceeding under military-mobilization rules, while 伏辜 means suffering punishment for one's crimes; 'submitted guilt' mistranslates the final clause.

proposals.before: Just at the spring growing time, I am about to send Remonstrance Grandee Li and others to recommend wronged prisons in Sanfu, Sanhe, and Hongnong.
proposals.after: Just at the season of spring growth, I am about to send Remonstrance Grandee Li and others to review cases of wrongful imprisonment in Sanfu, Sanhe, and Hongnong.
proposals.reason: 冤獄 denotes cases of wrongful imprisonment; they are to be raised and reviewed, not 'recommended' as prisons.

proposals.before: Just spring growing time, about to send Remonstrance Grandee Li etc. recommend Sanfu, Sanhe, Hongnong wronged prisons.
proposals.after: Just at the season of spring growth, about to send Remonstrance Grandee Li and others to review wrongful-imprisonment cases in Sanfu, Sanhe, and Hongnong.
proposals.reason: 冤獄 denotes cases of wrongful imprisonment; they are to be raised and reviewed, not 'recommended' as prisons.

proposals.before: On dingchou day of the eighth month, Grand Empress Dowager Wang collapsed.
proposals.after: On dingchou day of the eighth month, Grand Empress Dowager Wang died.
proposals.reason: In an imperial annal, 崩 denotes the death of a sovereign or senior imperial person; 'collapsed' is a semantic mistranslation.

proposals.before: Eighth month dingchou day, Grand Empress Dowager Wang clan collapsed.
proposals.after: Eighth month dingchou day, Grand Empress Dowager Wang clan died.
proposals.reason: The royal death verb 崩 means 'died' here, not physical collapse.

proposals.before: On Gengchen of the tenth month of winter, the Empress Dowager ordered officials to restore the Ganquan Supreme Altar, Fenying Houtu, Yong Five Altars, and Chencang Chenbao sacrifices.
proposals.after: On Gengchen of the tenth month of winter, the Empress Dowager ordered officials to restore the Ganquan Supreme Altar, Fenyin Houtu, Yong Five Altars, and Chencang Chenbao sacrifices.
proposals.reason: The place name 汾陰 is Fenyin; 'Fenying' adds an unsupported final g.

proposals.before: Winter tenth month Gengchen, Empress Dowager edict officials restore Ganquan Supreme Altar, Fenying Houtu, Yong Five Altars, Chencang Chenbao sacrifices.
proposals.after: Winter tenth month Gengchen, Empress Dowager edict officials restore Ganquan Supreme Altar, Fenyin Houtu, Yong Five Altars, Chencang Chenbao sacrifices.
proposals.reason: The place name 汾陰 is Fenyin; 'Fenying' adds an unsupported final g.

proposals.before: Runan Governor Yan Hong captured and beheaded Ling and the others.
proposals.after: Runan Governor Yan Xin captured and beheaded Ling and the others.
proposals.reason: The Chinese name is 嚴訢; 訢 is Xin, not Hong. 閎 is a different person named earlier in the range.

proposals.before: Runan Governor Yan Hong captured beheaded Ling etc.
proposals.after: Runan Governor Yan Xin captured beheaded Ling etc.
proposals.reason: The Chinese name 嚴訢 is Yan Xin; rendering 訢 as Hong confuses him with 閎.

proposals.before: Hong was moved to Grand Minister of Agriculture and granted 100 catties of gold.
proposals.after: Xin was moved to Grand Minister of Agriculture and granted 100 catties of gold.
proposals.reason: The subject 訢 continues Yan Xin from s0220, so 'Hong' has the wrong referent and given name.

proposals.before: Moved Hong to Grand Minister of Agriculture, granted gold 100 catties.
proposals.after: Moved Xin to Grand Minister of Agriculture, granted gold 100 catties.
proposals.reason: 訢 is the shortened reference to Yan Xin from s0220, not Hong.

proposals.before: The Commander of the Capital Region Commandant shall inspect those who do not change.'
proposals.after: The Capital Region Commandant shall inspect those who do not change.'
proposals.reason: 司隸校尉 is a single office; “Commander … Commandant” doubles the title and obscures the referent.

proposals.before: Those in position are silent and silent, rarely having loyal words.
proposals.after: Those in position are silent, rarely having loyal words.
proposals.reason: 默然 is a single adverb; repeating “silent and silent” is unnatural English that obscures the sense.

proposals.before: Enfeoffed Xiao Chancellor's descendant Xi as Marquis of Tan.
proposals.after: Enfeoffed Xiao Chancellor's descendant Xi as Marquis of Zan.
proposals.reason: 酇 is Zan (Xiao He's fief), not Tan; the place-name in the title is mistranslated.

proposals.before: Enfeoffed Xiao Chancellor descendant Xi as Tan Marquis.
proposals.after: Enfeoffed Xiao Chancellor descendant Xi as Zan Marquis.
proposals.reason: Literal English also renders 酇 as Tan instead of Zan.

proposals.before: In the third month, advanced noble rank to duke, and Zhou Chenghou Marquis all to dukes, with lands each 100 li.
proposals.after: In the third month, advanced noble rank to duke, and the Zhou Marquis of Chengxiu also to duke, with lands each 100 li.
proposals.reason: 承休 is Chengxiu, not Chenghou; the English title corrupts the fief name and the grammar around 皆.

proposals.before: Third month, advanced noble rank to duke, and Zhou Chenghou Marquis all to dukes, lands each 100 li.
proposals.after: Third month, advanced noble rank to duke, and Zhou Chengxiu Marquis all to dukes, lands each 100 li.

decisions.reason: 悼考 is one posthumous designation; splitting it as Dao Kao invents two name elements for the single temple title 悼考廟.
Literal English likewise splits 悼考; the disaster predicate applies to 悼考廟, the temple of Daokao.
